results.description:
Explore realistic airplanes in the most electrifying airborne flight simulator - Airplane Pro: Flight Simulator! 
Jump into the pilot seat to command your own fleet of aircrafts and experience the highs of flying in one of the most immersive flying simulators!

Take flight in real aeroplanes through an ever-expansive open-world flight simulator. Explore the skies above realistic scenery and airports in high fidelity with satellite map imagery. Witness towering skyscrapers, runways, air traffic, weather conditions, and true volumetric clouds to bring you a new level of immersion for the ultimate flight simulation.

Perform a wide variety of over 27 free missions to become a professional airplane pilot or explore free mode where you can explore the world!

Pilot are you ready for your first mission!
- Pass pilot school to get your flight license!
- Airplane emergency landings to put you to the test in real piloting simulations!
- Load up with passengers and safely transport them to their destinations
- Fly high class VIPs and the presidential private jet or lead the Airforce jet planes to escort them safely!
- Rescue victims after plane accidents, can you save the day?
- Rough situational landings, can you land on an aircraft carrier or safely crash land into water?
- Test your skills in checkpoint challenges
- Keep control of your aircraft during extreme weather situations or engine malfunctions
- Take small advertising jobs in your small planes showing banners in the sky

Airplanes aren't the only vehicles we have to offer!
Get behind the wheel of some fast cars if you prefer scenic route, drifting throughout the huge open world landscape!

If you're preparing for the skies then the realistic dynamic weather with day and night cycles, turbulence and disastrous winds might catch your off guard if you're not careful!
Immerse yourself in the dynamic world of flight simulation! Experience the thrills of piloting an aircraft through extreme thunderstorms or snowstorms.

- Explosive action packed plane crashes with realistic airplane physics
- Fully control your plane from the cockpit with radio, lights and passenger interaction controls
- Huge range of aircraft types from commercial airliners to jets to small biplanes
- Enter any vehicle you see! Airplanes, cars & boats the world is yours to explore

Your adventure awaits as the next pro pilot in Airplane Pro: Flight Simulator!
Download now to join us in the skies and elevate your piloting adventures!

results.description:
Conquer routes worldwide, fly amid real traffic and build your fleet!
Create the best airline in the world and manage dozens of airliners.
Fly from the main hubs to open thousands of routes towards all the major airports of the world.
Earn from contracts, completing takeoffs, landings, taxiing and exciting challenges in hundreds of airports with realistic runways and high definition regions.
Increase your automatic earnings thanks to the routes you open and conquer the sky!

There are hundreds of licenses available to improve your skills. Learn how to use all airplanes controls, and to cope with faults, emergencies and unfavorable weather conditions. The more you improve the more you earn with your airline; build the definitive fleet amid real-time air traffic!

Features:
- Dozens of airliners to build your definitive fleet: turbine, reaction, single deck or double deck
- Dozens of main hubs with taxiways to open thousands of routes towards all the major airports of the world
- Hundreds of realistic airports and runways. Regions and airports with high definition satellite images, maps and worldwide navigation
- Thousands of different situations to handle during takeoff, landing, and all taxiing and airborne phases
- Real-time air traffic, with real airlines, on the ground and in flight
- Simplified flight system with navigation help or flight simulation for advanced users
- Realistic SID/STAR takeoff and landing procedures with pushback system, taxiing and the possibility to dock at the finger with individual display
- Compete against pilots and airlines from all around the world to prove you're the best
- Realistic different times of the day with sun, moon, stars and real-time weather conditions
- Customizable airline livery

Technical details of the flight simulator:
- Control tower communication to manage air traffic and provide assistance
- Takeoffs and landings from basic to advanced and with Instrument Landing System (ILS)
- Primary Flight Display and Navigation Display
- Advanced engine system with startup, faults and fire suppression
- Fuel management with weight balancing, fuel dumping, real consumption, stall, APU and engine pressure
- Autopilot with control of all flight parameters: altitude, speed, heading and vertical speed
- Failure of sensors, instruments, ASM, fuel tanks, landing gear and engines
- Malfunction of flaps, rudder, air brakes and radar
- Hydraulic faults, tire problems, fire on board
- Wind, turbulence and fog with various levels of severity
- Ice and severe frost with ANTI-ICE system
- Weather Radar to manage microbursts and faults caused by lightning

Support:
For problems with the game and suggestions please write to: airlinecommander@rortos.com

results.description:
WORLD OF AIRPORTS

Build, manage, and grow your aviation empire in one of the most realistic airport management games on mobile.

World of Airports combines airport operations, airline management, fleet planning, and multiplayer strategy into a unique aviation experience. Take control of real-world inspired airports, coordinate aircraft movements, optimize ground handling operations, and build a global airline network connecting players from around the world.

Whether you dream of managing a busy international hub, expanding a regional airport, or creating a world-class airline, every decision matters.

MANAGE REALISTIC AIRPORT OPERATIONS

• Coordinate aircraft arrivals and departures
• Assign gates and optimize airport traffic flow
• Manage airport capacity and operational efficiency
• Expand airport infrastructure and unlock new opportunities
• Balance resources, schedules, and profitability

Every aircraft requires a carefully coordinated turnaround. Passengers board and deboard, baggage is loaded and unloaded, aircraft are refueled, and ground services must be completed before departure. Efficient planning is essential to keep flights on schedule and maximize airport performance.

BUILD YOUR AIRLINE

• Create and grow your own airline
• Collect and operate a diverse fleet of aircraft
• Customize liveries and showcase your brand
• Open new routes and expand your network
• Earn rewards through strategic fleet management

From regional aircraft to wide-body airliners, every aircraft plays a role in your airline’s growth. Build a fleet that reflects your strategy and establish your presence across the global aviation industry.

PLAY WITH REAL PLAYERS

World of Airports features a unique multiplayer system where aircraft operated by real players travel between airports managed by other players.

• Service aircraft from airlines around the world
• Send your own fleet to other players’ airports
• Participate in global events and challenges
• Compete in rankings and leaderboards
• Join one of the largest aviation gaming communities

Every airport becomes part of a living global aviation network where your decisions influence both your airport and your airline.

EXPERIENCE AUTHENTIC AVIATION

World of Airports is designed for players who appreciate the complexity and beauty of modern aviation.

• Airports inspired by real-world locations
• Realistic aircraft models and airline liveries
• Detailed aircraft turnaround operations
• Strategic airport and airline management
• Live weather based on real-world METAR reports
• Dynamic airport environments
• Constantly evolving content and new destinations

Weather conditions change throughout the day, affecting airport operations and creating new challenges. From clear skies to reduced visibility, every airport operates within a dynamic environment inspired by real aviation conditions.

PLAN, OPTIMIZE, EXPAND

Success depends on efficient resource management, careful planning, and strategic decision-making. Optimize aircraft turnaround times, maximize airport capacity, improve service efficiency, and expand your operations to handle increasing traffic.

As your airport grows, so do the challenges. Larger fleets, more passengers, and higher traffic volumes require smarter planning and better coordination.

FOR AVIATION ENTHUSIASTS

Whether you are fascinated by aircraft, airport logistics, airline operations, airport infrastructure, or aviation strategy, World of Airports offers a deeper level of realism than traditional airport tycoon games.

Experience the challenge of coordinating ground services, managing airport resources, expanding facilities, operating airline fleets, and maintaining smooth airport operations in a living multiplayer aviation world.

Join more than 40 million players worldwide and discover why World of Airports has become one of the world’s leading airport management games.

Build your airport.
Grow your airline.
Connect the world.

"Turboprop Flight Simulator" is a 3D airplane simulator game, in which you pilot various types of modern turboprop aircraft, and also drive ground vehicles.

* C-400 tactical airlifter - inspired from the real-world Airbus A400M.
* HC-400 coastguard search and rescue - variant of C-400.
* MC-400 special operations - variant of C-400.
* RL-42 regional airliner - inspired from the real-world ATR-42.
* RL-72 regional airliner - inspired from the real-world ATR-72.

* XV-40 concept tilt-wing VTOL cargo.

* MV-40 special operations VTOL - variant of XV-40.

* MS-26 special operations seaplane - variant of PS-26.
* C-130 military cargo - inspired from the legendary Lockheed C-130 Hercules.
* HC-130 coastguard search and rescue - variant of C-130.
* MC-130 special operations - variant of C-130.


HAVE FUN:

* Learn to fly with training missions (teaching the basics of flying, taxiing, takeoff and landing).
* Complete various missions.
* Explore the plane's interior in first-person (in most levels, and free-flight).
* Interact with various items (doors, cargo ramp, strobes, main lights).
* Drive ground vehicles.
* Load, unload, and airdrop supplies and vehicles with the cargo planes.
* Takeoff and land on improvised runways (and airports, for sure).

* Use JATO/L (Jet Assisted Take-Off and Landing).
* Fly in varied time-of-day, fog and wind conditions.

* FREE airplane simulator game updated in 2025!
* NO MANDATORY ADS! Only optional, rewarded ones in-between flights.
* Good 3D graphics (with detailed cockpits for all the airplanes).
* Realistic physics for flight simulation.
* Complete pilot controls (including rudder, flaps, spoilers, thrust reversers, auto-brakes, and landing gear).
* Multiple control options (including mixed tilt sensor & stick / yoke).
* Multiple cameras (including cockpit cameras with captain and copilot positions).

* Partial and total aircraft destruction (clipping wing tips, full wings separation, tail separation, and main fuselage breakage).

* Selection of measurement units for air speed, flying altitude, and distance (metric, aviation standard, and imperial).

In this game, you're not just a pilot — you're part of a living, breathing world in the skies. Each level features fully animated cutscenes and scripted sequences that give players a feel of real-life commercial aviation. From takeoff to touchdown, you’ll witness the daily adventures and challenges of modern air travel.
Welcome aboard the most immersive and cinematic flight simulator experience yet! Step into the skies with “Airplane Journey: Sky Legends” — a next-gen airplane game where each level unfolds like a movie, blending realistic flight mechanics, dynamic weather, and compelling storytelling across multiple scenarios flight game.
Level 1 begins at a bustling airport, where passengers board Flight No. 1112. Experience the thrill of departure and scenic mid-air views as clouds roll by. Land with grandeur as fire trucks welcome you with a water cannon salute — a tradition honoring a special flight’s arrival.
Level 2 introduces the behind-the-scenes action. Start in a hangar, taxi your aircraft to the terminal, and board passengers under dramatic skies. Watch out for sudden weather shifts and bird strikes — test your piloting reflexes in critical moments, and land safely under the guidance of ground crew.
Level 3 ramps up the intensity with an unexpected onboard emergency. When a passenger falls gravely ill mid-flight, it’s a race against time. Coordinate with air traffic control, make an emergency landing, and ensure medical aid is ready as soon as wheels touch the ground.
Level 4 slows things down with a realistic and peaceful flight experience. Oversee refueling, manage boarding, and witness the professionalism of the cabin crew serving meals at cruising altitude in airplane simulator. Land smoothly and watch passengers exit with satisfaction.
Level 5 offers a VIP treatment. Host influential personalities onboard, witness their protocol-driven arrival, and ensure a smooth and luxurious flight experience. Land in style as media and luxury vehicles await these special guests, marking a grand finale to your aviation journey.
From realistic aircraft models and airport environments to emotional storytelling and emergency scenarios, Airplane Journey: Sky Legends delivers both a simulation and an adventure. Whether you're here for calm cruising or crisis management, your piloting skills and decision-making will be put to the test.
Fasten your seatbelt, captain pilot simulator— your journey through the skies begins now!
